question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: An arbitration panel sanctioned by FINRA Dispute Resolutions Services ordered Raymond James & Associates to pay two employee advisors, Michael Kuras and Patrick Marsh, close to $1.86 million in compensatory damages and interest, in a dispute dating back to Raymond James' 2016 purchase of Deutsche Bank's U.S. private wealth group (Alex. Brown brand).
items.quote: An arbitration panel sanctioned by FINRA Dispute Resolutions Services ordered the firm to pay two advisors close to $1.86 million in compensatory damages and interest in a dispute that harkened back to Raymond James' purchase in 2016 of Deutsche Bank's U.S. private wealth group, which operates as the Alex. Brown brand.

items.text: According to the arbitration panel's ruling, Marsh is to receive $1.23 million in damages (including interest) and Kuras $628,000, stemming from Kuras and Marsh's 2023 suit against Raymond James alleging breach of contract, wage theft, civil theft and other claims.
items.quote: According to the arbitration panel's ruling, Marsh is to receive $1.23 million in damages, which includes interest, and Kuras $628,000.

items.text: According to the arbitration panel's ruling, Kuras is to receive $628,000 in damages.

The arbitration panel found there was no agreement between Raymond James and the two advisors governing the distribution of the prior arbitration award or the allocation of legal fees, and adopted a proportionate approach factoring in the advisors' 40% grid rate share of the recovery.
items.quote: This panel has found there was no agreement between [Raymond James] and [Kuras and Marsh] governing the distribution of the prior arbitration award or the allocation of legal fees... the panel adopted a proportionate approach, factoring in [the advisors'] percentage share of the recovery equivalent to the 40% grid rate

items.text: A FINRA arbitration panel had earlier found Deutsche Bank liable on all 10 loan transactions and awarded Raymond James $16.4 million in compensatory damages and accrued interest, ruling the brokerage firm was jointly and severally responsible for remitting any portion owed to Kuras and Marsh.
items.quote: a FINRA arbitration panel found Deutsche Bank liable on all 10 loan transactions and awarded Raymond James $16.4 million in compensatory damages and accrued interest.

cells.reason: The passages disclose a FINRA arbitration award and related prior Deutsche Bank arbitration, which are regulatory/legal developments attributed to Raymond James.
